snippet.title: Scarlet Deer Inn - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Scarlet Deer Inn, our dark medieval folk tale with physical embroidery, releases July 21 on Steam!
Wishlist:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/1553260
Console versions are set to follow as soon as possible.

Music: Nevernica by @strigonband
